method.inventory: All correlated actual-script composition tuples, in both genders and both stage/avatar profiles; visible tuples are separately corroborated by ScriptRunner.
method.geometry: Fresh native skeleton at each authored key time and 120 Hz sample, direct source body/mouth/eye application, actual Reader actor render with native looping and blink scheduling.
method.repetition: First frame, complete eye cycle, two repeat-cycle phases, complete one-shot blink and reopen.
method.transitions: Unique existing-actor expression pairs from sourceTransitions, with exact source-operation/witness joins. Each pair is tested before, during and after a native blink, at zero delta and after a positive delta.
method.occlusion: Source UV-masked white texels, iris-relative projection, clipping and blend-aware layered opacity audit joined per eye; matching Reader geometry preserves source occlusion and attachment detachment.

limitations: Route enumeration abstracts external playthrough state and crosses conditional branches as explicit structural candidates; no global condition satisfiability claim is made.
Equivalent character membership/expression/visibility states share one representative source-position and source-entry witness. Their infinitely many loop histories are not duplicated.

Timed samples use locally settled phase-entry opacity. Cross-visit fade continuation, arbitrary player interruption times, CG occlusion and viewport cropping are retained as source metadata rather than certified framebuffer visibility.
Asset readiness here verifies registered resources and native clip existence. It does not itself observe browser rendering or native game playback.
Static source images have no authored Spine catchlight timeline. Text-only, missing-resource and unbound identities remain explicit inventory records.
Exhaustive native composition/lifecycle replay is distinct from representative production-browser recordings.
External story predicates are abstracted into structural branch candidates, with explicit developer overrides; no single-playthrough or global branch-satisfiability claim is made.
Existing Rover avatar approximations are verified against their selected effective source clips; they do not establish the appearance of absent literal channels.
Layered source samples and Reader recordings do not establish equivalence to a running original-game Unreal/LGUI framebuffer.
